# CamCraft 0.15-Sgt_Hindsight

This is a community test build of the current 0.15 code from [linuxguy123/Camcraft](https://github.com/linuxguy123/Camcraft), at commit `{{SHA}}`. It is separate from the original 0.15.0 release. The toolbar and Debug Info show `0.15-Sgt_Hindsight` so screenshots identify this build.

Please test the setup workflow and report what works, what does not, and what you would change. In particular, check stock behavior across setups, which coordinate axes appear in each setup, whether toolpaths follow the intended machining axes, and what happens when a different G54–G59 register is selected.

The Cargo and package-manager version remains 0.15.0. A DEB or RPM may therefore conflict with an existing 0.15.0 installation; use the portable archive or AppImage to test alongside it.
